title: vektor /// no. 045 — Anthropic's AI-native SDLC playbook, installable.
description: Anthropic published how they actually build software with AI, and the interesting part is not the AI. Every stage now ends by committing a file: an idea becomes intent.md, which triggers spec.md, which triggers plan.md, which triggers the code. Each handoff is a git commit, so the chain doubles as your audit trail for free. Plus both guardrail layers — skills the agent follows, hooks that block it outright — and the one thing AI is never allowed to do.
og_title: Every stage ends by committing a file. — vektor /// no. 045
og_description: The artifact chain: intent.md to spec.md to plan.md to the diff, one commit per handoff. Skills are policy the agent follows; hooks are scripts that block it. AI reviews every PR and can never approve its own code.

tw_description: Reversible consequence, a skill is enough. Irreversible, it must be a hook. Policy is not protection. The whole playbook, one page.
